objective: Frozen computation: delta and the irreducible distance on every knot tree with six knots under every law assignment, and on random mixed knot trees of seven to nine knots with at most three knots per distinction; the hub identity on small hubs.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 4 of 4 predictions held): on every six-knot tree under every law assignment (1,216 bases, 94,848 pairs) and on 80 random seven-knot trees with at most three knots per distinction (8,400 pairs), delta and delta_K are steps apart on every pair and agree.
title: Both distances one size past and on larger trees
